name: Wise Owl
desc: Perched owl with blinking eyes and optional speech sparkles
code: const s = ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const col=ctx.color||'#8B6B4A'; const headCol='#9B7B5A'; const earCol='#7B5B3A'; const blink = Math.sin(mt*0.8)>0.95?0:1; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; svg += `<ellipse cx="0" cy="2" rx="7" ry="9" fill="${col}" stroke="${'#6B4B2A'}" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="0" cy="-8" r="6.5" fill="${headCol}" stroke="${'#6B4B2A'}" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; svg += `<polygon points="-5,-13 -3,-19 -1,-13" fill="${earCol}"/>`; svg += `<polygon points="1,-13 3,-19 5,-13" fill="${earCol}"/>`; if(blink){ svg += `<circle cx="-3" cy="-9" r="3" fill="#FFD700" stroke="#DAA520" stroke-width="0.5"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="3" cy="-9" r="3" fill="#FFD700" stroke="#DAA520" stroke-width="0.5"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="-3" cy="-9" r="1.5" fill="#222"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="3" cy="-9" r="1.5" fill="#222"/>`; } else { svg += `<line x1="-5" y1="-9" x2="-1" y2="-9" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<line x1="1" y1="-9" x2="5" y2="-9" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } svg += `<polygon points="0,-7 -1.5,-5 1.5,-5" fill="#DAA520"/>`; if(ctx.talk){ for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ const stx=10+i*5+Math.sin(mt*3+i)*3; const sty=-12+Math.cos(mt*2+i*1.1)*4; svg += `<circle cx="${stx}" cy="${sty}" r="${1.5-i*0.2}" fill="#FFD700" opacity="${0.4+Math.sin(mt*2+i)*0.3}"/>`; } } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
